Messages.Author: Henrik Isaksson
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I'm curious on the timing of Clotho's Gift (and Nu's ability). They both
read:
"once during each of your minion phases, this vampire can burn 1 blood to
untap."

Can this be done at any time? And in particular in these two cases:

1. Nu calls a refrendum for Domain Challenge. Befrore the votes are tallied
Nu decides to untap, saving his Methueslah a pool. Legal?
2. Nu is tapped with one blood. Rake invites Nu to a 5th tradition. Before
the action has resolved, Nu untaps with his last blood, and is then filled
up. Legal?

-
Henrik Isaksson

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henrik Isaksson wrote:
> I'm curious on the timing of Clotho's Gift (and Nu's ability). They both read:
> "once during each of your minion phases, this vampire can burn 1 blood to untap."
>
> Can this be done at any time? And in particular in these two cases:

No. Only during your minion phase.

> 1. Nu calls a refrendum for Domain Challenge. Befrore the votes are tallied
> Nu decides to untap, saving his Methueslah a pool. Legal?

Yes.

> 2. Nu is tapped with one blood. Rake invites Nu to a 5th tradition. Before
> the action has resolved, Nu untaps with his last blood, and is then filled
> up. Legal?

Yes.
